fixer.title: Agent Host: replace unacknowledged send_message queued messages and keep the session model

introducer.title: Implement queueing for busy target chats in send_message tool

cases.mechanism: Repeated send_message calls to a busy target previously appended a fresh pending message each time. After the active turn completed, the queue drain serialized all of those stale entries into separate full agent/provider turns, multiplying model/network work and delaying the latest update linearly with the number of follow-ups.
cases.symptom: Busy target chats could accumulate many stale same-sender turns, causing avoidable LLM requests and making the final/current update wait behind all earlier follow-ups.
cases.fixedBehavior: Same-sender follow-ups now reuse and replace the sender's existing undelivered queue entry, bounding that sender to one pending provider turn while preserving FIFO position and separate messages from other senders.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, every busy-target send_message dispatches ChatPendingMessageSet with a fresh generateUuid() id, so the reducer appends each follow-up. QueueDrainContribution consumes queuedMessages[0] after each successful turn and calls host.sendTurnMessage for every entry, making each stale follow-up a separate provider/model turn. The changed path finds the same source chat's still-undelivered entry and dispatches ChatPendingMessageSet with that existing id, which the reducer upserts in place; tests establish that multiple same-sender sends leave one queued message while different senders remain distinct.
